newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - September 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - September 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The government will buy an additional 0.1 million tonnes of rice this year from farmers to give them price support.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has said her government is working on a fresh education policy giving stress on science and technology.
India will remove all non-tariff restrictions on exports from Bangladesh and cut duty on 13 categories of items by 50 percent, Indian External Affairs Minister I K Gujral said in Dhaka.
Former President H M Ershad was brought to hospital on Saturday for medical check up. Doctors said Ershad was suffering from kidney and liver problems.
The next ministerial level meeting between Bangladesh and India will be held in New Delhi in late October to further discuss the contentious issue of the Ganges water sharing.
Singapore based investment company, Van Der Horst Technologies, is willing to set up two power plants, each with 100 megawatt capacity, in Bangladesh, an executive of the company said.
